subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'RAT' is coded as '39' and 'MICE' is coded as '30'. How will 'ZEBRA' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Sum of the position values according to English alphabetic series are written.

So,

 
• 'RAT' is coded as '39'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d1648a3c05346ccf03f4a482ccb12ca258f6105b02c308513f267c7d0027fd1.png] 

And,

 
• 'MICE' is coded as '30'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/382ff59bfcb423786c253eb4782a4e695427c1eb540ad038e256d9f06454aea3.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'ZEBRA' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d1639d37c466337f7fb17533084b3bb97bd57fbfc6b7cd8fd1536859bcb4ab4.png] 

​Hence, "52" is the correct answer.

53
